text: The Archive of the Reach. Speak softly, the papers are sleeping.
Have you brought me something? Please say you've brought me something.
{player}! What treasures today?
Crownbreaker! Sit, sit. I still have a splinter of it in a jar, you know.
Your Majesty. Sorry. Habit. Well, new habit.
The Warden of the Drowned! The sea's been calmer since. I've charted it.
Any luck with the shards? Salt, Ash and Mist. I've been reading nothing else.
You've found more of the Reach's history than my last three assistants combined.
Your encyclopedia's coming along nicely.
Listen to that thunder. Nobody sane is at sea tonight.
Storm's right on top of us. Stay in the dry a while.
Every timber in the harbour's groaning. Ugly night.
Wretched rain. Gets into everything.
Rain again. Good for the cisterns, bad for the soul.
You're dripping on my floor, by the way.
Late to be wandering about.
Night's when the cursed come walking. Keep a lantern lit.
Can't sleep either, eh?
Up with the gulls, I see.
Early start, {player}.
Mist'll burn off by mid-morning.
Happy {festival}, {player}! Everyone's in good spirits.
It's the {festival}. Half the town's drunk and the other half's working on it.

options.label: The Hollow Crown. What should I do with it?
I'd like some blank charts. (2 doubloons)
What sort of things do you collect?
Tell me about the drowned city.

text: Messages in bottles, washed up or fished up. Logs from sunken ships. Paintings from vaults and drowned halls.
Instruments, too. The great and terrible carry them. Don't ask me why; I've a theory involving morale.
Read each one, and it goes in your encyclopedia. Bring them to me and I'll pay for the originals.
Salt sank with the city: beneath the temple floor, in the grotto. You'll want a diving helmet.
Ash went up the fire mountain on Emberfall with a herald of the old court. If he's still there, he won't be friendly.
Mist is on the Isle That Isn't. It's on your chart now. The shrine only gives up its shard at night.
Two of three! The last one should be calling to the others. Can you feel it?
Far to the east, past Stormbreak and well beyond. It should be on your chart.
The Pretender sits in the old throne hall. Bring friends, bring powder, and bring the shards.
It's yours to decide. I'll tell you what I think each choice means, and then I'll keep my mouth shut.

Break it, and no one wears it again. Wear it, and the cursed will bow to you, and the Tidewatch will hate you. Give it back to the deep, and the drowned city will rest, and the sea will remember you kindly.

options.label: Return it to the drowned city.

text: Vesh Amaru. A city of pale towers that went under in an afternoon.
The diver at Crooked Reef sells helmets. Bring me back a painting.
